## Summary

<!-- The problem and what it cost, then what this change does about it. Link the issue it resolves (`Closes #123`); a pull request needs an agreed issue first. Someone reading this months from now has only this PR and the history, so spell out the reasoning instead of leaning on an internal label or a file they won't have. -->

## What changed

<!-- Grouped by logical area. If users would notice the change, add an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, written for users; otherwise say "No user-facing change, no changelog entry." If the change alters what the plugin writes to notes, where it puts them, or when it marks them, say so here: those are the rules that protect users' vaults. -->

## How it was tested

<!-- Each command you ran and what it printed, quoted, e.g. `npm test`: `pass 210`, `fail 0`. `npm test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` must all pass. For a new or changed test, say how you saw it fail without the fix. For sync behavior, name the test that runs a whole sync and checks a second sync changes nothing (`syncCycle` and `assertConverged`). If you tried it in Obsidian, give the Obsidian version and platform. -->
